name: sigimax
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.0.2"

package:
  name: sigimax
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/DataLab-Platform/SigimaX/releases/download/v${{ version }}/sigimax-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 0aa304e2a7924cee092fcdbc03c48f6123c361c5aee33da38e7e62f02c70908a

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps -vv --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - guidata >=3.15.0
    - plotpy >=2.11.0
    - qtpy >=1.9
    - psutil >=5.7
    - sigima >=1.2.0

tests:
  # For noarch Python packages, conda-forge checks both the minimum and the
  # latest supported Python.  pip_check does not require a concrete Qt binding.
  - python:
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
      pip_check: true

  # SigimaX itself is Qt-binding agnostic (through QtPy), just like guidata and
  # PlotPy.  Install one binding only for the functional import test.
  - requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pyqt
    script:
      - python -c "import sigimax; assert sigimax.__version__ == '${{ version }}'"
      - python -c "from sigimax import SGMXMainWindow; from qtpy import API_NAME; print(API_NAME)"

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/DataLab-Platform/SigimaX
  repository: https://github.com/DataLab-Platform/SigimaX
  documentation: https://sigimax.readthedocs.io/
  summary: Reusable GUI components and application utilities, part of the DataLab platform for signal and image processing
  description: |
    SigimaX is a Python library providing reusable Qt-based GUI components
    and application utilities for scientific signal and image processing
    applications. It builds on Sigima and the PlotPyStack libraries and
    provides the common application framework used by DataLab and other
    derived applications.
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - PierreRaybaut
